records.label: Plan Identity / Name / Lifecycle
records.notes: Named membership plans and plan lifecycle are market baseline.

records.label: Trial / Signup Fee / Tax References
records.notes: Trials/signup pricing are parity; tax calculation remains commerce/provider-owned.

records.label: Membership State / Expiration / Grace Period
records.notes: Active/expired/cancelled membership states are parity and remain distinct from payment/user state.

records.label: Role / Capability Mapping References
records.notes: Role mapping is market-evidenced; actual role/capability grants remain Surface 30/Policy-owned.

records.label: Payment Provider Boundary
records.notes: Billing changes require a provider adapter and cannot be inferred from local membership state.

records.label: Content / Resource Restriction Rules
records.notes: Restriction is market parity and must remain server-authoritative.

records.label: Consent Fields
records.notes: Consent remains an explicit compliance/policy contract rather than being inferred from generic checkout fields.

records.label: Transaction / Reconciliation Reference
records.notes: Local membership state reconciles against canonical transaction/provider evidence; UI state is not payment truth.

records.label: Idempotency / Notification / Privacy Diagnostics
records.notes: Webhook/payment idempotency and duplicate suppression are explicit WPE reliability guarantees.

coverage.notes: All Membership records are market classified. Plans/pricing/restrictions/changes are parity; provider payment truth remains external, and consent/reconciliation/idempotency remain explicit WPE hardening contracts.
